title: Add remote operator configuration schema for enabled gateways, allowed projects, allowed workflows, approval policy, budget ceilings, and emergency stop controls
summary: Create the policy configuration that keeps remote operation scoped, dry-run-first, budget-aware, and stoppable.
acceptanceCriteria: Configuration defines enabled gateways, allowed users, allowed projects, allowed workflows, live action allowlists, approval-required actions, budgets, and emergency stop.
Emergency stop blocks remote operation at policy level.
reviewNotes: Implemented RemoteOperatorConfig, remote_operator_config, authorize_remote_request, live action allowlist checks, budget fields, and emergency stop behavior.
